# Stakich Websites

> Stakich Websites (https://stakichwebsites.com) builds and maintains websites for small businesses. Owner: Jeremy Stakich, based in Tennessee, serving businesses anywhere in the United States. Websites are typically live in 1–2 weeks. No contract. The client does not have to build, host, or maintain anything.

## Pricing

- Starter: $199 setup + $49/month. Up to 5 pages, mobile-friendly; tap to call or text, plus a quote form; monthly hosting, HTTPS, security, and backups; built to show up in Google search; 2 small updates each month (new photos or text changes).
- Growth: $299 setup + $79/month. Everything in Starter; up to 8 pages; 1 blog post written for you each month; blogs ready to share on social media; Google reviews section; share buttons on every page.
- Pro: $499 setup + $129/month. Everything in Growth; up to 12 pages; online booking, menu, or quote tools; 2 blog posts each month; priority same-day updates when possible; I manage and update your Google and Bing listings. From the start, add me as Manager. If you don't have a Google or Bing listing yet, you'll need to set that up.
- Blog posts and the privacy policy page don't count toward the page limit.
